hypothesis: Replace only the post-oracle chain-state decision with strict task-local score elitism: install a proposed fragment-edited molecule if and only if its returned oracle score is strictly greater than its chain parent's score, and otherwise retain the parent. This makes every persistent chain a monotone local best-so-far trajectory and prevents the invalid raw proposal asymmetry from overruling objective feedback.
method_thesis: Extract a vocabulary of single-attachment fragments from the allowed unlabeled corpus without scoring or retrieving any whole corpus molecule, and start one persistent molecular-graph Markov chain from each of the ten fixed evaluated molecules. In every feedback round, generate one fresh candidate per chain through a locally sanitized, reversible fragment-add or fragment-delete transition, retrying locally until the batch contains ten novel canonical molecules. After the oracle returns, accept each proposed state with a Metropolis-Hastings probability for an annealed score density, including its forward/reverse proposal ratio; rejected proposals leave their chains at the previous states. Low inverse temperature initially permits controlled downhill moves that can cross structural valleys, while increasing concentration later favors high-score states. Thus all oracle calls evaluate de novo molecular constructions, and feedback directly steers persistent search paths toward a stronger final Top-1 without a surrogate, a learned generator, or finite-library screening.

applicability_conditions: Each objective supplies stable finite scores on a maximize-is-better scale, so the candidate-versus-parent comparison is meaningful without cross-task calibration.

Useful chemistry is reachable through a sequence of nondecreasing single-fragment additions or deletions from at least one of the ten fixed initial states; the mechanism is less likely to transfer when improvement requires accepting a downhill or score-tied structural stepping stone.

The retained state's novel one-edit neighborhood under the 64-fragment vocabulary and 400-heavy-atom ceiling must remain large enough to fill all 29 protocol-sized adaptive batches despite strict rejection leaving some chains at the same parent for multiple rounds.

The change addresses objective-blind chain installation, not the mathematical reversibility of the permanently novelty-filtered emitted proposal process; raw forward/reverse quantities remain audit diagnostics and no reversible-MH claim is made for the new gate.

On flat or heavily quantized objectives, strict tie rejection may freeze chain states and reduce multi-step exploration even though fresh one-edit candidates continue to be emitted; such settings are outside the claimed advantage unless their retained neighborhoods remain productive.
research_intent.falsifier: The mechanism is falsified if any scored candidate with score_delta <= 0 is installed, any candidate with score_delta > 0 is not installed, any resulting chain score is lower than its immediately preceding score, or replay shows that beta or the raw reverse-to-forward proposal ratio still changes an installation decision. If all decisions satisfy the strict predicate but the score does not improve, the mechanism activated but was not useful rather than failing to occur.

Preserve the existing seeded RNG consumption for each scored transition so the change does not also alter the number of random draws, and retain beta, raw forward/reverse probabilities, and their log ratio as diagnostics only, with an explicit receipt that they contribute zero to the state decision. Log whether each transition satisfies the strict elitist predicate and verify the resulting chain score and molecule after installation or retention. Leave corpus preparation, the 64-fragment vocabulary, single-fragment add/delete construction, proposal sampling and retries, candidate-side canonicalization, global and within-batch duplicate rejection, the 400-heavy-atom ceiling, ten persistent chains, feedback matching, bounded fallbacks, batch size, and JSONL protocol unchanged.

research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Parent n-bda394f7cde0 completed all 29 seed-0 feedback rounds after the size-ceiling repair, but its chain-state decisions remained dominated by the inherited raw reverse-to-forward proposal correction rather than by objective improvement. Across its 1,450 scored transitions, the mean absolute logged proposal correction was 3.309245 while the mean absolute annealed score term was only 0.011067: 1,199 of 1,200 additions were installed, including 477 of 478 downhill additions, whereas only 10 of 250 deletions were installed and 93 genuinely improving deletions were rejected. The rule accepted 480 negative-score moves and rejected 93 positive-score moves; final mean chain score was below its initial mean on four of five objectives, and median_2 and zaleplon_mpo made no terminal Top-1 improvement. Node n-718111259202 additionally established that these raw proposal ratios are not valid for the emitted process because permanent candidate novelty makes every evaluated parent unavailable as an emitted reverse endpoint and retry-until-survivor normalization is omitted. Raising the ceiling in n-bda394f7cde0 restored completion but deliberately retained this structurally driven state-update behavior.

A productive nondecreasing path existed on every tested task. The Candidate installed 325 strict improvements, terminal chain means exceed initial chain means on all five objectives, and summary.json reports final Top-1 above initial Top-1 on all five.

The retained-state neighborhoods were sufficient under the fixed 64-fragment vocabulary, 400-heavy-atom ceiling, ten chains, and 29 adaptive rounds. The confirmed claim is only about the post-oracle chain-state gate. Raw forward/reverse probabilities, inverse temperature, and the preserved uniform draw remain audit telemetry, and the evidence makes no claim that the novelty-filtered emitted proposal process is reversible Metropolis-Hastings sampling.
Applicability beyond search seed 0, these five fixed objectives, batch size 10, 300 calls per task, the observed one-edit neighborhoods, and the current fragment vocabulary is unestablished.
